options.name: disabled
options.description: Optional. Flag which enables/disables B(Policy). Defaults to I(false).

options.name: method

options.name: pools
options.description: Optional. List of B(Pool) objects assigned to B(Policy). Defaults to I(empty).

options.name: portal_key
options.description: The API token for authentication against Infoblox BloxOne API. If not set, the environment variable E(INFOBLOX_PORTAL_KEY) will be used.

options.name: portal_url
options.description: The Infoblox Cloud Services Portal (CSP) URL. If not set, the environment variable E(INFOBLOX_PORTAL_URL) will be used.

options.name: rules
options.description: Optional. List of B(TopologyRule) objects defining the resolving strategy for B(Policy). Defaults to a list of single, default B(TopologyRule).

options.name: state
options.description: Indicate desired state of the object

options.name: tags
options.description: Optional. The tags for B(Policy) in JSON format.

options.name: ttl
options.description: Optional. Time to live value (in seconds) to be used for records in DTC response. Unsigned integer, min: 0, max 2147483647 (31-bits per RFC-2181).
